issue_context.title: CEL validation can cause APIServer to crashloop
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

We observed a scenario that can cause APIServer to crash due to a CEL validation issue for CRD.
There's an edge case that when a CRD schema is updated after a CR instance is created, CRD finalizer can cause APIServer to crash when the CRD is being deleted.
Updating the CRD schema after some CRs are created can be problematic, but it should fail gracefully instead of crash.

~~Even if I manually delete the CRD and CR from etcd, it seems it doesn't help recovery. CRD finalizer somehow still panic and crash apiserver.~~

**EDIT**: Deleting CRD and CR can help APIServer to recover in the next restart.
@mengqiy Thanks for the stack trace. That's really helpful. Can you describe in any more details how to reproduce?
the description has crd / cr / crd2 needed to reproduce the issue
i can confirm i repro-ed it using `hack/local-up-cluster.sh` just now.

I think the bug is that the CRD was allowed to change from `type: array` to `type: object` while still defining `items`. That update should be prevented (ratcheting). That should prevent CRDs from newly hitting this issue on update.

To deal with CRDs that already got updated weirdly like this, additional guards are probably needed:
* Something else is likely assuming presence of `items` means the type is an array, so should check if type contradicts that
* Something *else* likely needs a type assertion checked when dealing with data in the actual CR compared to the schema-declared type

> additional guards are probably needed

Yep, looks like we have:

CEL assumes type="object" means object: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/302d350e88eac519e1df020b82256371c171b861/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/cel/common/schemas.go#L73

structural schemas assumes presence of "items" means array: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/bf7770f92fb4dde0f6d8f558d76c2571c8907bd1/staging/src/k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver/pkg/apiserver/schema/convert.go#L78

>Can you describe in any more details how to reproduce?

Content for crd, cr and crd2 are already in the issue body. You should be able to see them if you uncollapse them.

Thanks for the issue. Will work on it :)
